steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ evaluation state on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable counter offers on RFQs as required by the case.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Send Vendor A a counter offer changing the bid price from 100 to 90.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks the counter offer as initiated for Vendor A.
Have Vendor A accept the pending counter offer in the supplier portal.
Verify the buyer's Responses grid marks Vendor A's counter offer as accepted.
Open the buyer's Master QCS after acceptance and verify Vendor A is present.
Verify Master QCS uses the accepted current price of 90 for Vendor A.
Verify Master QCS calculates the line amount and total from the accepted rate and quantity, including 90 × 10 = 900.
